description: Search and count your Graylog log messages, pause and resume streams, turn event definitions on and off, search alerts and send log messages. Start a workflow for each new alert or matching message, or when a count of messages crosses a threshold.

graylog_message_count_threshold_trigger.description: Runs when the number of messages matching a search over the last few minutes goes above (or below) a threshold, such as more than 50 failed logins in 5 minutes, once per crossing. It runs again only after the count has come back.

parameters.description: What to find, as typed in Graylog's search bar, such as level:3 AND source:web-01. Leave blank for every message.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only messages in this stream, by name or id. Leave blank for every stream the token can see.
parameters.name: stream

parameters.description: How far back each look counts, such as 5m or 1h. Defaults to 5m.
parameters.name: window

parameters.description: Goes above or goes below the threshold. Defaults to goes above.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: The count it crosses, such as 50.
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.description: A field to count separately for each of its values, such as source. Leave blank for one total.
parameters.name: group_by

graylog_new_event_trigger.description: Runs for each new event or alert Graylog raises, oldest first, such as each high-priority alert, up to 50 a look. Events raised before the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only events of this event definition, by title or id. Leave blank for every event definition.
parameters.name: event_definition

parameters.description: Alerts and events (the default), alerts only, or only events that aren't alerts.
parameters.name: include

parameters.description: Only events of this priority or higher. Defaults to any priority.
parameters.name: priority

graylog_new_message_trigger.description: Runs for each new log message that matches a search, oldest first, such as each failed login in a stream, up to 50 messages a look. Messages logged before the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: What to find, as typed in Graylog's search bar, such as level:3 AND source:web-01. Leave blank for every message.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only messages in this stream, by name or id. Leave blank for every stream the token can see.
parameters.name: stream

parameters.description: Other fields to get with each message, separated by commas, such as level, user_name.
parameters.name: fields
